name: Dev-via-spec Challenger Accept → Architect-light Handoff
description: When the dev-via-spec-challenger emits decide(action=accept), the adversarial gate has passed and the plan is committed. This rule fires on that signal and spawns the dev-via-spec-architect-light specialist for the final shaping pass — mapping the planner's epic decomposition to the research artifact's actors and integration points and emitting the final epic-shaped seed_requirements list. The architect-light's decision is terminal — no further rule fires. R3.3 of the ADR-031 phasing.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.dev-via-spec-architect
on_enter.prompt: The dev-via-spec challenger accepted the plan. Challenger loop id: $entity.id (passed as prior_loop_id in your task properties). Call read_loop_result with that loop id to read the challenger's verdict; the chain context is summarised in the verdict's reason field (the challenger summarises the plan it accepted). Synthesise the final epic-shaped seed_requirements list per your `10-output-contract.md`, grounding each final SR to a planner epic the challenger's reason cites. Terminate with decide(action=seed_requirements_emitted, reason="<final list>"). No rule fires on your decision — your terminal closes the dev-via-spec arc.

metadata.pattern: architect-light (ported from SemSpec architect, scoped down — research artifact provided actors/integration_points)
metadata.terminal_role_note: architect-light's decide(seed_requirements_emitted) is terminal. No rule matches it. Adding a downstream rule (e.g. publishing to an external consumer) is additive — the typed payload contract for that emission would be a follow-up ADR-031 §addendum, mirroring R3.2.1's emit_research_artifact pattern.
metadata.cross_grounding_caveat: Same caveat as rules 01 and 03. The architect-light reads only the prior challenger loop. The challenger's accept reason summarises the plan; the architect-light grounds final seed requirements against the epics the challenger cites. Direct addressability of the planner and research-reviewer loops requires rule-engine property-passthrough that beta.27 doesn't ship. R3.4 or upstream improvement should add forward-propagation; until then the architect-light's persona is defensive — its 10-output-contract.md flags any final SR whose grounding chain breaks.
